##### Project general facts

The Trump Cliff Villas represent a historic collaboration between the iconic Trump Organization and DarGlobal. Located within the prestigious Aida master-planned community, these residences are dramatically perched on cliff tops high above the Gulf of Oman. The collection comprises exquisitely designed villas, each managed under the hallmark quality and impeccable service synonymous with the Trump brand, offering owners a peerless standard of living.

Owners are granted privileged access to an extraordinary world of amenities. At the heart of the community lies the spectacular Trump International Golf Club, a championship course offering breathtaking sea views and a world-class playing experience. Residents enjoy exclusive membership to the opulent members-only club, complete with a cigar bar, luxury spa and gym, and a private infinity pool. The adjacent Trump International Hotel provides five-star indulgence, featuring world-class dining, a private beach, and the groundbreaking Cliff Hanging Night Club, ensuring every desire is effortlessly met.

The Trump Cliff Villas are the epitome of turnkey luxury, meticulously curated to the highest standard of sophisticated living. True to the promise of uncompromising excellence, every detail, down to the last teacup, is furnished to perfection, allowing owners to move into a residence that is as complete as it is exquisite. Expansive interiors feature striking cubic architecture with floor-to-ceiling windows framing panoramic ocean views. Designed for seamless indoor-outdoor living, these residences ensure that the daily reality for owners is one of unparalleled beauty and tranquility.


##### Location description and benefits

Perched majestically on the cliffs overlooking the Gulf of Oman, this exceptional destination places residents at the heart of one of the world's most breathtaking coastal landscapes. The location offers a serene and private sanctuary, where dramatic rocky canyons meet pristine turquoise waters, creating an atmosphere of pure, undisturbed tranquility.

Strategic advantages are equally compelling. Within easy driving distance of Muscat International Airport and downtown Muscat, it offers effortless connectivity to the capital's cultural and business hubs, including UNESCO World Heritage Sites, the Royal Opera House, and the Sultan Qaboos Grand Mosque. This unparalleled accessibility ensures residents enjoy both seclusion and seamless connection to world-class destinations.

Beyond its natural splendor, this location is central to the long-term national vision of Oman, positioning the nation as a premier global destination for high-end tourism and investment. With Oman ranked among the leading countries for quality of life and recognised as one of the safest countries in the world, this enclave offers a rare combination of security, serenity, and sophisticated living, attracting discerning individuals who demand nothing less than the extraordinary.
